name: Grupo Toky S.A.
summary: Grupo Toky S.A. engages in the retail of furniture and home decor. It retails various articles in the furniture, decorative items, sofa, wardrobe, mattresses, office chairs, dinning sets, furniture, bed, table and bath, decoration, children, lighting, garden and leisure, and household utensils. The company engages in activities related to the logistics of furniture to third parties. It sells its products through its physical stores and its websites. Grupo Toky S.A. was formerly known as Mobly S.A. and changed its name to Grupo Toky S.A. in May 2025. The company was founded in 2011 and is based in São Paulo, Brazil.
